_source: CIS110_LN182_Fall2026_Second8Weeks_Final_SimpleSyllabus.pdf, page 9 (project) and page 23 (calendar and rubric). Change a value here only when the syllabus changes; crates/core/tests/syllabus.rs pins each one. Since T10 (2026-10-20), the C1 and C2 descriptions differ from the syllabus: the shared folder moved from C1 to C2, and teams talk in a Blackboard team discussion first. The dates were unchanged by T10. Since T11 (2026-10-20), C3 to C5 are a week earlier than the syllabus (9, 16 and 23 November), so every file is in before Thanksgiving and the prototype is built over the break. Since T16 (2026-10-21), C5 also asks for a recording of one member presenting the slides, recording_min to recording_max minutes; the syllabus doesn't mention it.
